title: Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan: Parts Discount, Labour Ceiling, Visit Excess and Term Spend Ceiling
content:
Four figures govern what the host pays and what the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan meets on work that falls outside an allowance: the discount the plan holds on parts, the highest hourly labour rate the plan will meet, the amount the host pays toward each visit, and the ceiling on what the plan will meet across one term. Amounts are in USD.

| Plan | Parts discount (percent) | Highest hourly labour rate met | Excess the host pays per visit | Ceiling on what the plan meets in one term |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | 5 | 95.00 | 25.00 | 600.00 |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | 10 | 115.00 | 15.00 | 1200.00 |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | 15 | 135.00 | 0.00 | 2500.00 |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | 18 | 155.00 | 0.00 | 4000.00 |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | 22 | 145.00 | 0.00 | 9000.00 |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | 15 | 165.00 | 0.00 | 3200.00 |

### Points of the schedule

An excess of 0.00 stands against a plan on which the host pays nothing toward the visit itself; only the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan, at 25.00, and the Keyturn Care Routine Plan, at 15.00, carry a per-visit excess at all.

The labour ceiling does not climb with the monthly fee across the whole card: the Keyturn Care Electric Plan meets the highest hourly rate of the six at 165.00, above the 145.00 met on the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan, whose term spend ceiling of 9000.00 is nonetheless the largest.

The parts discount is the same 15 percent on the Keyturn Care Complete Plan and on the Keyturn Care Electric Plan, and rises to 22 percent only on the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan.
